description.text: Grants [Attach Water with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Serah (Water)], [Apex Transcendent Arrow Damage Tracker] and [Apex Transcendent Arrow Level]

description.name: Attach Water with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Water Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Water 3

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Serah (Water)
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Apex Transcendent Arrow (0~2), removed after using Apex Transcendent Arrow two times

description.name: Apex Transcendent Arrow Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Apex Transcendent Arrow level by 1 after dealing 100001 or 300001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Serah (Water)]

description.name: Apex Transcendent Arrow Level
description.text: Keeps track of Apex Transcendent Arrow level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Serah (Water)]
